events.message: Inspecting the home feed and safe video embeds.
Building the video composer, saved media API, and privacy-first inline player.
Video feed, composer, and responsive cards are built; wiring RSS media and validation tests.
Five URL/RSS/input tests pass. Reviewing API ownership and keyboard-friendly feed actions.
Video sharing and RSS media are complete. Six targeted tests, scoped lint, and production build pass; awaiting integration review.
Researching 15 distinct official media/accessibility websites, then refining video behavior and tests.
Read 15 distinct official websites and documented decisions. Refined loading, captions, transcripts, and feed race guards; six tests, lint, and build pass.
Reviewed 15 sites. Video publishing, inline YouTube playback, media validation, and feed checks pass. Ready for a new mission.
Building recommended community tags, long-press card actions, sharing, and a saved personal channel.
Built community recommendations, persisted repost/share APIs, card action dialogs, and long-press drag targets.
Reviewing membership and channel permissions, rollback behavior, drag geometry, and share intent encoding.
Eight targeted tests pass. Finishing drag cancellation, current membership refresh, keyboard fallback, and 15-site evidence.
Recommended joins, three drag bubbles, saved personal channel, and community attachments are complete. Eight tests, scoped lint, and build pass; awaiting browser integration.
Replacing generic fallback with topic-relevant publisher and topic images.
Topic images now preserve publisher art and use relevant Wikimedia assets. Skyrim and Redis live checks passed; Hebrew/Unicode and bounded cache tests passed.
Building saved comment threads, replies, reaction notifications, and visible repost actions on every card.
Saved comments, replies, personal comment history, and real notifications are built. Live Mongo ownership, deduplication, rollback, and concurrent reaction tests passed.
Comments and notifications are complete. Live Mongo tests cover privacy, deduplication, rollback, and concurrent reactions; scoped lint and production build pass.
Relevant artwork, card sharing, reposts, persistent comments and notifications verified. Ready for a new mission.
Unique per-card artwork is ready: missing/broken images and shared topic covers get deterministic individual frames. Three artwork tests, scoped lint, and build passed.
Unique artwork, card actions, comments and notifications passed tests and browser review. Ready for a new mission.
Building shared mixed-feed video cards and deterministic source deduplication for the For you feed.
Unified mixed-feed cards and standalone video sharing are ready. Four mixing/safety/render tests, scoped lint, and production build pass; no sample videos or separate feed sections.
Unified video cards, preserved sharing/transcripts and common content actions verified. Ready for a new mission.
